nodes.label: quicKFS Threat Model
nodes.rationale: Clients and the network are untrusted; the server host, export owner, identity state, account administration, pairing-secret distribution, managed pin channel, and configured roots are trusted. A compromised server private key permits impersonation wherever the client's trust policy accepts its certificate. Traffic analysis, compromised endpoints, production recovery/live-session revocation, per-user export isolation, formal protocol analysis, and large distributed availability attacks are out of scope for the prototype.
